description: prediction-protocol — PreToolUse gate on the Bash tool: a one-way command (migration, force-push, merge, deploy, restart, remote exec, mutating HTTP, grants/secrets, recursive delete) is denied unless the session holds an open receipt for that exact command; outside the protocol it asks. Fail-closed: any gate error or deadline overrun denies. A PostToolUse hook marks a consumed receipt as fired once its command actually ran; a second PreToolUse hook denies Edit/Write into the protocol's own session state. A SessionStart hook exports PREDICT=<plugin>/bin/predict so consumers can call "${PREDICT:?}" (on Codex, which has no env file, the path goes into the session context). Codex has no hook ask: where the gate asks on Claude Code it denies on Codex, and a matching receipt passes silently; Codex file edits (apply_patch) are guarded by the same state hook.
